/*********************************************************************/
/*  Type Definitions                                                 */
/*********************************************************************/

typedef struct _DIR DIR;  /* Directory Stream.  This is an incomplete
                             type.                                   */

#define _QP0L_DIR_NAME 640 /* size of d_name field of dirent
                              structure                              */

#define _QP0L_DIR_NAME_LG 2550 /* size of d_name field of dirent_lg
                                                       structure @A6A*/


/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/
#define d_reserved2 d_fileno_gen_id

struct dirent {
  char           d_reserved1[16];  /* Reserved                       */
  unsigned int   d_fileno_gen_id;  /* File number generation ID  @A1C*/
  ino_t          d_fileno;         /* The file number of the file    */
  unsigned int   d_reclen;         /* Length of this directory entry
                                      in bytes                       */
  int            d_reserved3;      /* Reserved                       */
  char           d_reserved4[8];   /* Reserved                       */
  qlg_nls_t      d_nlsinfo;        /* National Language Information
                                      about d_name                   */
  unsigned int   d_namelen;        /* Length of the name, in bytes
                                      excluding NULL terminator      */
  char           d_name[_QP0L_DIR_NAME]; /* Name...null terminated   */

};


#if ((!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) \
   || ((defined _POSIX1_SOURCE) && (_POSIX1_SOURCE != 1)))    /* @A6A*/

struct dirent_lg {
 char            d_lg_reserved1[16]; /* Reserved                 @A6A*/
 unsigned int    d_lg_fileno_gen_id; /*File number generation ID @A6A*/
 ino_t           d_lg_fileno;        /*File number of the file   @A6A*/
 unsigned int    d_lg_reclen;        /* Length of this directory
                                            entry in bytes       @A6A*/
 int             d_lg_reserved3;     /* Reserved                 @A6A*/
 char            d_lg_reserved4[8];  /* Reserved                 @A6A*/
 Qlg_Path_Name_T d_lg_qlg;           /* Qlg structure            @A6A*/
 char            d_lg_name[_QP0L_DIR_NAME_LG]; /* Name...not
                                            null-terminated      @A6A*/
};

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720)                                   /* @A9A*/
struct Qp0lReaddirName             /* Simple name format         @A9A*/
{
  qlg_nls_t      d_nlsinfo;        /* National Language Information
                                      about d_name               @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_namelen;        /* Length of the name, in bytes
                                      excluding NULL terminator  @A9A*/
  char           d_name[_QP0L_DIR_NAME]; /* Name...null terminated
                                                                 @A9A*/
};

struct Qp0lReaddirNameLg           /* NLS-enabled name format    @A9A*/
{
 Qlg_Path_Name_T d_lg_qlg;         /* Qlg structure              @A9A*/
 char            d_lg_name[_QP0L_DIR_NAME_LG]; /* Name...not
                                            null-terminated      @A9A*/
};

struct Qp0lReaddirAttrDirent       /* Dirent attribute format    @A9A*/
{
  char           d_reserved1[16];  /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_fileno_gen_id;  /* File number generation ID  @A9A*/
  ino_t          d_fileno;         /* The file number            @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_reclen;         /* Length of this directory entry
                                      in bytes                   @A9A*/
  int            d_reserved3;      /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved4[8];   /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
};

struct Qp0lReaddirAttr001          /* Attribute format 001       @A9A*/
{
  char           d_reserved1[24];  /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_reclen;         /* Length of this directory entry
                                      in bytes                   @A9A*/
  mode_t         d_mode;           /* Mode                       @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved3[26];  /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_read_only;   /* PC read-only flag          @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_hidden;      /* PC hidden flag             @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_system;      /* PC system flag             @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_archive;     /* PC archive flag            @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved4[2];   /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  qp0l_objtype_t d_objtype;        /* Symbolic object type       @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved5[5];   /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
};

struct Qp0lReaddirAttr002          /* Attribute format 002       @A9A*/
{
  time64_t       d_create_time;    /* Object creation time       @A9A*/
  time64_t       d_modify_time;    /* Data modification time     @A9A*/
  char           reserved1[8];     /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_reclen;         /* Length of this directory entry
                                      in bytes                   @A9A*/
  mode_t         d_mode;           /* Mode                       @A9A*/
  time64_t       d_access_time;    /* Last data access time      @A9A*/
  time64_t       d_chkout_time;    /* Last checkout time         @A9A*/
  char           d_chk_user[10];   /* Checkout user profile      @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_read_only;   /* PC read-only flag          @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_hidden;      /* PC hidden flag             @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_system;      /* PC system flag             @A9A*/
  char           d_pc_archive;     /* PC archive flag            @A9A*/
  char           reserved3[18];    /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  unsigned long long d_size;       /* Data size in bytes         @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_extended_attr_size; /* Extended attribute size in
                                        bytes                    @A9A*/
  char           reserved4[4];     /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
};

struct Qp0lReaddirAttr003          /* Attribute format 003       @A9A*/
{
  char           d_reserved1[8];   /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  time64_t       d_modify_time;    /* Data modification time     @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_fileno_gen_id;  /* File number generation ID  @A9A*/
  ino_t          d_fileno;         /* The file number            @A9A*/
  unsigned int   d_reclen;         /* Length of this directory entry
                                      in bytes                   @A9A*/
  mode_t         d_mode;           /* Mode                       @A9A*/
  time64_t       d_access_time;    /* Last data access time      @A9A*/
  time64_t       d_chkout_time;    /* Last checkout time         @A9A*/
  char           d_chk_user[10];   /* Checkout user profile      @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved3[4];   /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  unsigned short d_nlink;          /* Number of links to object  @A9A*/
  qp0l_objtype_t d_objtype;        /* Symbolic object type       @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved4[5];   /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  unsigned long long d_size;       /* Data size in bytes         @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved5[16];  /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
  unsigned long long d_alloc_size; /* Allocation size in bytes   @A9A*/
  time64_t       d_change_time;    /* Attribute change time      @A9A*/
  char           d_sys_archive;    /* System archive flag        @A9A*/
  char           d_remote;         /* Local/remote flag          @A9A*/
  char           d_non_savable;    /* Savable flag               @A9A*/
  char           d_nwsstg;         /* Network storage space flag @A9A*/
  char           d_case;           /* Case-sensitivity flag      @A9A*/
  char           d_oflow;          /* ASP overflow flag          @A9A*/
  char           d_stg_free;       /* Storage freed flag         @A9A*/
  char           d_file_format;    /* *TYPE2 stream file flag    @A9A*/
  char           d_alwckpwrt;      /* Allow checkpoint writers
                                      during save-while-active   @A9A*/
  char           d_signed;         /* Digitally signed flag      @A8A*/
  char           d_dir_format;     /* *TYPE2 directory flag      @A9A*/
  char           d_system_signed;  /* Trusted signature flag     @A9A*/
  char           d_sisvtx;         /* Restricted rename/unlink   @A9A*/
  char           d_virtual_vol;    /* Virtual volume flag        @A9A*/
  char           d_temp_fs;        /* Temporary file system flag @A9A*/
  char           d_temp_obj;       /* Temporary object flag      @A9A*/
  char           d_preferred_storage_fs; /* File system storage
                                            media preference     @A9A*/
  char           d_inherit_alwckpwrt; /* Inherit allowing checkpoint
                                         writers                 @A9A*/
  char           d_sys_restricts_save; /* System restricts save  @A9A*/
  char           d_reserved6[21];  /* Reserved                   @A9A*/
};

struct Qp0lReaddir_T            /* Qp0lReaddir() extensions      @A9A*/
{
  char attrFormat;              /* Attribute format              @A9A*/
  char nameFormat;              /* Name format                   @A9A*/
  char threadSafe;              /* Read directory safely         @A9A*/
  char sortedOrder;             /* Sort the returned entries     @A9A*/
  char asyncBring;              /* Bring objects asynchronously  @A9A*/
  char patternType;             /* Pattern matching definition   @A9A*/
  char reserved1[10];            /* Reserved                      @A9A*/
  char *patternName;            /* Pattern to match              @A9A*/
  size_t entryBytesProvided;    /* Entry buffer size             @A9A*/
  size_t entryBytesReturned;    /* Total size of output entries  @A9A*/
  char reserved2[24];           /* Reserved                      @A9A*/
};

/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants for attrFormat field                                    */
/*********************************************************************/
#define QP0L_READDIR_ATTR_DIRENT 0x00 /* Qp0lReaddirAttrDirent   @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_ATTR_001 0x01    /* Qp0lReaddirAttr001      @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_ATTR_002 0x02    /* Qp0lReaddirAttr002      @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_ATTR_003 0x03    /* Qp0lReaddirAttr003      @A9A*/
/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants for nameFormat field                                    */
/*********************************************************************/
#define QP0L_READDIR_NAME 0x00        /* Qp0lReaddirName         @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_NAME_LG 0x01     /* Qp0lReaddirNameLg       @A9A*/
/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants for threadSafe field                                    */
/*********************************************************************/
#define QP0L_READDIR_THREADSAFE_NO 0x00  /* Not threadsafe       @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_THREADSAFE_YES 0x01 /* Threadsafe           @A9A*/
/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants for sortedOrder field                                   */
/*********************************************************************/
#define QP0L_READDIR_SORTED_NO 0x00    /* Unsorted entries       @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_SORTED_YES 0x01   /* Sorted entries         @A9A*/
/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants for asyncBring field                                    */
/*********************************************************************/
#define QP0L_READDIR_ASYNCBRING_NO 0x00   /* No bring            @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_ASYNCBRING_FILE 0x01 /* Bring files         @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_ASYNCBRING_DIR 0x02  /* Bring directories   @A9A*/
/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants for patternType field                                   */
/*********************************************************************/
#define QP0L_READDIR_PATTERN_NONE 0x00      /* No pattern        @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_PATTERN_POSIX 0x01     /* POSIX matching    @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_PATTERN_POSIX_ALL 0x02 /* POSIX-ALL match   @A9A*/
#define QP0L_READDIR_PATTERN_PC 0x03        /* PC matching       @A9A*/
#endif                                                        /* @A9A*/

#endif  /* _POSIX_SOURCE  */
